changelog:
Brave Browser Agent 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Attach to user-controlled Brave Browser (port 9222) for automation; does not manage browser lifecycle.
- Supports content extraction, robust clicking (multi-framework), script execution, tab listing, and screenshots.
- Adds anti-detection strategies: CDP-native user events, multi-strategy SPA click handling (React/Vue/Angular).
- Includes health check/diagnostic scripts and advanced commands for editor sync, page analysis, and element interaction.
- Comprehensive documentation with strict rules forbidding browser start/restart.
- Provides CLI quick-starts, troubleshooting, and framework-aware automation guidance.
summary: Control Brave Browser via CDP for web browsing, content extraction, screenshots, and JavaScript execution. Use when needing browser automation, web scraping,...
